interfaces.summary: Re-verified all 9 claimed findings against the actual portal source. All 9 are REAL and confirmed from concrete file:line evidence — none were false positives. tree.go covers all 8 rendered pages with correct routes and nav order; the gaps are (a) three label-text/stale discrepancies in tree.go and (b) a cluster of UI template binding bugs where dashboard/checklists/deadlines templates reference struct fields that do not exist on the raw model types the handlers pass in (model.Client has ContactEmail not Email, and no StageProgress method; model.ClientChecklist has none of Title/Progress/ProcedureType/CompletedSteps/TotalSteps/Steps; model.Deadline has no StatusClass/StatusLabel). These cause html/template execution errors (logged, partial page). I raised severity on the shared-header Email bug (breaks every authenticated page) and the checklists-page bug (whole page body), and ADDED one binding bug the first auditor missed: the dashboard "Документы сопровождения" block binds .StatusClass/.StatusLabel on raw []*model.ClientDocument.
interfaces.coverageNote: All 8 Portal pages plus the two special-layout pages (login, notifications) are present in tree.go with correct routes and nav order; remaining gaps are label-level in tree.go plus several UI template binding bugs (fix-ui), not tree omissions.

interfaces.summary: Re-verified all 9 claimed findings against src/chat_widget/widget.go and chatWidget() in src/navindex/tree.go (lines 113-154). All 9 are confirmed REAL — no false positives to drop. The standalone /chat block (tree.go:126-128) and both API routes (/api/session, /api/chat) are accurately described (header «Консультант Сколково», theme toggle tooltip «Переключить тему», tab title «Чат — Сколково», welcome, «Печатает…», «Ошибка соединения.», placeholder + tooltip «Нажмите Enter для отправки», send «Отправить» tooltip «Отправить сообщение» all match). The genuine gaps cluster in (a) the interface-level HowTo, which mislabels the floating bubble as «Консультант» (the bubble actually shows only a chat-icon with tooltip «Открыть чат»; «Консультант» is the PANEL header that appears after opening), and (b) the shallow /chat-widget.js block, which omits 5 user-visible strings the widget renders: floating-button tooltip «Открыть чат», close-button tooltip «Закрыть чат», send-button tooltip «Отправить сообщение (Enter)» (note: different wording from the standalone page), typing indicator «Печатает…», and connection-error «Ошибка соединения.» — plus the widget's injected welcome message. One standalone label («Enter — отправить, Shift+Enter — новая строка») is stale: it is keyboard-handler behavior (keydown, no rendered text — grep for «Shift»/«новая строка» returns zero matches), not a visible hint. Adjustment vs. the first auditor: downgraded the widget typing-indicator finding from medium to low for parity with the connection-error finding (both are transient status texts, not navigable controls).

interfaces.summary: Re-verified all 16 claimed findings against the real renderers (src/admin/templates.go, src/admin/shell.go navMain, src/admin/admin.go label helpers, src/analytics/analytics.go) and mainAdmin() in src/navindex/tree.go (lines 270-411). Confirmed and kept 13 findings, dropped 1 false positive (the «Панель операций» item, which the auditor itself labelled a confirmation — the group labels Сбор данных/Индексация/Модерация and buttons all match tree exactly, so it is not a defect), and downgraded 2 over-rated ones (graph legend wording from medium→low; the /changes «Изменение» column item stays low/investigate). The two highest-value confirmed gaps are the Documents stat-card row (tree lists «Активные/Устарелые/Отклонённые/Индексировано» but the UI renders «Действует/Устарело/В индексе (RAG (поиск по векторам))» with NO «Отклонённые» card at all — templates.go:544-562) and the entire /analytics block (tree promises «графики активности/статистика по категориям/экспорт CSV», but the page renders 6 fixed cards — Документы по статусам, Клиенты по стадиям, Дедлайны, Мероприятия и конкурсы, Чек-листы, MCP-запросы — and has NO CSV button; export is API-only at admin.go:2450, the page header at analytics.go:530-538 only has a «Документы» back-link + theme toggle). findings.actual: The page has concrete navigable card titles a user could ask the bot to point to — «Документы по статусам», «Клиенты по стадиям», «Дедлайны», «Мероприятия и конкурсы», «Чек-листы», «MCP-запросы» — none of which are in tree.

Legend literals are «Ссылается (references)», «Замещает (supersedes)», «Связано (related)» — English suffixes, not colour names. The core labels Ссылается/Замещает/Связано are correct; only the parenthetical differs (downgraded from medium — minor wording).

Rendered line is «Версия {OldNo} ({OldAt}) → {NewNo} ({NewAt})» plus «всего версий: N» and «анализ: …»; tree's «Версия N → M» is an acceptable shorthand. The only genuine gap is that the specific severity-badge labels «Инфо»/«Важное»/«Критично» (and «Без ИИ-оценки») are not listed under the generic «бейдж важности».

«Последний обход сайта» ✓ and empty-state «Хранилище страниц сайта не подключено» ✓, but the count renders as «Страницы N–M из Total» (or «Найдено: 0»), optionally «(всего в базе: N)» — there is no literal «Показано страниц: N».

The table badge text comes from sitePageStatusLabel: «доступна» / «недоступна (404)» (lowercase, gone label includes «(404)»). The filter dropdown does say «Доступна/Недоступна» capitalised, but the badge in the table differs.

Select options are «Все», «Документ», «Новость», «Мероприятие», «Конкурс/грант», «НПА (нормативный акт)», «Льгота», «FAQ (частые вопросы)», «Telegram», «Страница сайта». tree shortens «Конкурс/грант»→«Конкурс», «НПА (нормативный акт)»→«НПА», «FAQ (частые вопросы)»→«FAQ» and omits «Все».

interfaces.summary: Re-verified all 17 claimed findings against ai_admin.go, regulations.go, proxy_page.go and tree.go lines 270-411. 15 are genuine and kept (2 severity-downgraded to match the label-wording class); 1 was dropped as a non-issue (the auditor itself admitted the Russian-proxy block is accurate in tree.go and the only nit was an in-page paragraph/button mismatch, not a tree discrepancy); 1 missing element was added (proxy type badge in the proxy list). The single highest-impact issue is confirmed and stands: the /ai/agents creation/edit FORM dropdown (ai_admin.go:1163-1168) and preset buttons (1185-1188) offer only 4 agent types; \"Аннотатор страниц\" (page_annotator) is absent even though it exists in the enum (types.go:68), is programmatically seeded as a default agent (store.go:313-345, EnsurePageAnnotatorAgent), and IS shown in the agents TABLE via AgentType.Label() (types.go:82-83). tree.go:406 claims the form includes \"Аннотатор страниц\", so a bot would direct users to a non-existent dropdown option — and the form itself is buggy (a valid, seeded agent type cannot be created/edited). The rest are label/column-wording paraphrases (last-column header is \"Действия\"/\"Действия и тест\" not the inline button names; \"Идентификатор модели (Model ID)\" not \"API Model ID\"; NPA law option \"Федеральный закон\" not \"ФЗ\"; \"Описание льготы\" not \"Описание\"), several missing empty-states, one missing required proxy field (\"Название\"), and the proxy \"Автопереключение на рабочий\" being a button rather than a toggle.

interfaces.summary: tree.go's mcpServer() (lines 414-439) models this interface as ONE page (/mcp) with 8 "section" blocks listing tool names. This is a pure JSON/MCP API (no html/template, no human-facing HTML) so there are no table headers, form fields, placeholders, empty-state messages or badges to mirror — the only user-visible elements are (a) the registered MCP tools and (b) the HTTP routes. I re-verified the full tool inventory: code registers exactly 36 distinct tool names across server.go + 7 *_tools.go files (4 server + 7 source + 4 regulation + 2 change + 8 residency + 9 agent + 1 nav + 1 sitepages), and tree.go's section Labels list exactly those 36 names — TOOL COVERAGE IS 1:1 with no missing and no stale/hallucinated tool. Only 2 HTTP routes exist on the mux (/health, /mcp); no extra routes or out-of-file tool registrations. Of the 3 claimed findings I KEPT 2 and DROPPED 1: kept the /health-not-a-Page omission and the unflagged-conditional-tools nuance; dropped the \"Более 35\" count finding as a false positive (more-than-35 is satisfied by 36 tools, and under the default config ELIGIBILITY_ENABLED=true + Generator-with-Postgres all 36 are live, so the wording is accurate by default and only looks high in a degraded config — pedantic, not a real distortion). No additional gaps were found.
interfaces.coverageNote: High coverage: all 36 registered MCP tool names appear in tree.go 1:1 (no missing, no stale). Only the /health route (not modeled as a Page) and the conditional registration of 3 agent tools are unmodeled; both are low-impact.

interfaces.summary: Re-checked all 9 claimed findings against src/tgbot/{bot,handlers,keyboard,auth}.go and telegramBot() in tree.go (442-521). All 9 are genuine and confirmed at concrete file:lines; none were dropped as false positives. One reclassification: the "8 stage descriptions" finding is better labelled kind=missing (tree.go merely summarizes "описание стадии (одно из 8: …)" — it does not state a wrong value, the 8 concrete emoji sentences at handlers.go:187-194 are simply absent), with recommendation fix-tree. The strongest defect remains the pagination glyphs: both DeadlineKeyboard (keyboard.go:36,39) and DocsKeyboard (keyboard.go:73,76) render «⬅️ Назад» / «Вперёд ➡️» (U+2B05/U+27A1 + FE0F) while tree.go:483,492 claim «◀ Назад» / «Вперёд ▶» (U+25C0/U+25B6) — 4 wrong glyphs across two routes that a bot would reproduce verbatim. The remaining confirmed gaps are uncaptured fallback/error messages: the unauthenticated text fallback (handlers.go:81), the unknown-command error (handlers.go:48), the «❌ Вы не авторизованы…» states (handlers.go:163/209/267/509/543), the store-error messages (handlers.go:215/273/515), and the /ask «📚 Источники:» header + «Ответ не найден.» fallback + «❌ Ошибка: %v» (handlers.go:372/360/353). No stale (non-existent) labels exist in tree.go beyond the wrong pagination glyphs.
